items.title: Perimeter enclosure
items.change: Nine explicit rings, 107 outward/return lots, connected pitched rear wings, and only purposeful retained courts. Church west range and both market returns close former aprons.

items.title: Street rank
items.change: Measured96px main route with an orthogonal bend,48px ordinary routes and24px service passages. Southeast has a48x96 setback; stale road/lot overlaps were removed.

items.title: Civic square
items.change: Guildhall north, attached church west, inn east and market with attached southern returns. The336x336 core, notch, six stalls and fountain approaches are retained.

items.title: Roof and return family
items.change: New terrace B supplies all six width/depth roofs and both hip hands; newly drawn whole corner and narrow west house supply real side volumes. Passing guildhall stays unchanged.

items.title: Roof contacts
items.change: Whole pitched rear roofs replace texture carpets. Native shared eaves and existing16px receivers join actual adjacent properties; shallow side elevations were lowered to avoid window clipping.

items.title: Market
items.change: Passing complete192x144 market retained; expanded southern ring and attached roofs enclose its sides and leave the north approach clear.

items.title: Gate
items.change: Passing coherent gate chamber, bearings, landing and stair retained unchanged, with wall-line towers and96px portal.

items.title: Entries
items.change: New inn blank sign bay preserves complete windows and porch. Courtyard arch interiors show existing painted pavement; jambs and thresholds are retained.

items.title: Signs
items.change: Passing physical signs remain unchanged. Inn sign moved to a measured clear bay; the tailor sign now retains every painted pixel in the normal city.

items.title: Curtain seams
items.change: Passing wall variants, their two-column joints and all25 pair proofs retained and regenerated.

items.title: Material scale
items.change: New roof drawings use larger coherent clusters with identical native tile scale across widths/depths; no roof-fill carpets remain in city composition.

items.title: Paving
items.change: New48px image-painted turn palette-matched to the approved road, with registered painted edge joints; moved to the actual cell-aligned bend.

items.title: Shadows
items.change: Continuous north-wall casts union without detached bright gaps; actual painted caster silhouettes and separate receiver masks retained, maximum alpha88.

items.title: Wall circulation
items.change: Passing north stair, walk and gate access art remain in wall bands with static access/reveal proofs.

items.title: Height hierarchy
items.change: Peripheral housing is predominantly1–2 storeys. Civic neighbours were lowered; three-/five-storey merchants remain central/east.

items.title: Variation
items.change: New corner bays/dormer; north and south rows now vary actual ground/storey/roof selections. Sliding five-lot runs are checked from selected layer filenames.

items.title: Precinct
items.change: Passing3x2-cell churchyard with slabs and market-side gate retained.

items.title: Court work
items.change: Northwest now uses the actual laundry rack, northeast sorting table is exposed by lower foreground lots, southwest woodpile moved inside its small court.

items.title: Inhabitants
items.change: Passing laundry worker, patrons, bench, delivery and stair guard retained beside their tasks; normal and reveal states regenerated.

items.title: Acceptance
items.change: All current asset, seam, repeat,16x12, square, unequal-height, actor, whole-city, comparison and enlargement sheets regenerated from the repaired sources.

precedence: BRIEF-17 and coordinator structure rules control streets, lots and allocations. No panel waiver enlarges the gate, market or lots, reduces sign scale or authorizes cross-property overlays.
acceptance: Measured static-art checks are not independent visual approval or runtime collision validation.
